note: Scarification edges target soil chemistry/temperature, not erosion. e35 (vegetation removal -> foredune erosion increased) excluded: vegetation removal is not worded as site preparation or scarification.
Flowering / flower stalks taken as reproductive success. Seedling size, cover and tree establishment edges excluded (not reproduction); soil moisture is not an amendment.

Only fish-related harvest edges (10.1002/hyp.13580: e5,e8,e13,e24,e27,e28,e33,e52,e59) measure weighted usable area / fish habitat, not fish populations; excluded under strict class membership. If habitat counted, that study would vote decrease.

Feeding-guild abundances (gatherers/filterers up, shredders/predators down near contamination) read as functional trait composition; single study internally mixed. Diversity indices and species composition edges excluded.
Only tilling disturbance -> introduced perennial grass cover (null) fits. Cover soil placement/type edges excluded as not site preparation; forage species not stated as non-native.

Oil in salt marsh: pore-water N unchanged, PAH above background. Lake/stream water chemistry edges (acid deposition, SO2) excluded as not soil chemistry; sewage sludge and N addition treated as amendments, not pollutants.

Woody debris edges concern small-mammal survival, not trees. Residual-tree edge e25 measures seedling stocking/density, not survival; strip-cut (e61) and tree shelters (e16) are not worded as structural retention.
